_meta.source: Google Analytics 4 (UN GA360) — UN News properties, aggregate reports pulled via the GA Data API
_meta.scope: Aggregated summaries. Initial approval 2026-07-30 (summaries only); scope broadened per Fang Chen's verbal go-ahead relayed 2026-08-04 (written confirmation pending — see ACTION_ITEMS.md). Regardless of scope, nothing raw, event-level, or user-level is ever published in this public repository.
_meta.license: Internal UN operational data published as aggregate summaries for the Atlas; not an open dataset — no public source URL exists.
_meta.sampling: GA reported no sampling on any request in this pull (empty sampling metadata).
_meta.method_note: GA measures arrivals on UN News web properties (visits by people who already found the site), NOT the reachable population of a country. Never compare GA figures directly with survey-based reach percentages; they are different constructs measured on different populations.
caveats: English-property traffic fell ~32% versus the previous 28 days (1.05M to 714k active users) while average session duration rose 89s to 107s — the drop tracks the cooling of the June US-Iran war news cycle, so period-over-period deltas are news-cycle driven, not structural.

China on the English property shows 108,860 users but only 107,354 page views and an 8.4% engagement rate versus 19-47% for the other top-10 countries (most cluster at 30-46%; Netherlands and France run lower and carry their own flags) — a bot/VPN-like pattern. Treat China arrivals as unverified until investigated; do not present China as the #2 engaged English audience.

The all-languages property shows the same China pattern (578,246 users vs 536,227 page views) — the implied Chinese-edition audience is likewise unverified; caveat it wherever the all-languages country list is quoted.

54% of English-property sessions are 'Unassigned' channel (no source attribution — likely feeds, apps, and consent-blocked traffic). Channel shares are therefore quoted as share of ATTRIBUTED sessions where the distinction matters.

GA's browser-language dimension is device locale, not language preference; the real language signal is which language edition people visit. Browser-language rows are included only to show the locale-vs-edition gap.
Netherlands and Singapore rank above population expectations with low engagement (23% and 21%) — datacenter/VPN suspicion; treat as directional.
IP-derived geography is directional, not exact; VPN and proxy use shifts country rows.

One story ('Security Council debrief: race for critical minerals') shows 4,892 views from only 689 users (7.1 views/user) — anomalous, possibly embed or refresh traffic; excluded from trend conclusions.
90% of English-property users in the window are new visitors, typical for search-driven news traffic; the returning core is ~74k users.

GA continues processing hits for up to ~48 hours after a day ends. This snapshot was retrieved 2026-08-04, the morning after the window closed, so a later check in the GA interface may show the final day's figures marginally higher (re-verified 2026-08-04: property totals identical; page-level rows drifted +0.02% to +0.3%; the All-languages rollup +0.2-0.9%). Quote figures as 'as retrieved 2026-08-04', or re-snapshot once the window is 48h old.
Demographics cover only the ~15-17% of users Google can classify (signed-in, consented; thresholding applied) — a non-representative subset, never the audience profile.
Monthly history: sessions were not collected before August 2021 (nulls, not zeros); September 2020 is the property's first (partial) month; August 2026 is partial.
The 90-day top-pages table includes a GA '(other)' cardinality bucket — its top rows are exact, the long tail is aggregated.
Timing (hour/day-of-week) is reported in the property timezone, America/New_York.

global_all_languages._note: Not currently displayed anywhere — the UN News section is scoped to the English edition for now (decision 2026-08-04). Kept for later integration.

channels.note: share_of_attributed_pct excludes the Unassigned row and uses the sum of the attributed rows from this same channel report as its denominator. GA's undimensioned session total differs slightly from the channel-dimensioned sum (a documented GA reporting quirk), so shares are computed within one report, never across two.

top_sources.note: sessionSource, top rows. '(not set)' is the unattributed block behind the Unassigned channel.

browser_languages.note: Device locale, NOT language preference — see _meta.caveats. Shown only to expose the locale-vs-edition gap (e.g. 48.7k Chinese-locale devices read the English edition).

demographics.coverage_note: Google can classify age for only 15.2% of users and gender for 17.2% (signed-in, consented users via Google Signals; GA flagged the response subject_to_thresholding). monthly.note: Full property history at monthly grain. GA4 collection on this property began September 2020; the sessions metric was only collected from August 2021 (null before that — an instrumentation gap, not zero traffic). August 2026 is a partial month (through Aug 3).
